title: Sita
desc: Ram, a young boy, lives in a monastery waiting for Sita to return and take care of him. However, Sita returns, years later, but with an ulterior motive.

title: Ekai Eksho
desc: Ratan, an honest autorickshaw driver, refuses to help a corrupt politician, Pradip Roy, which then leads to a local war. He also ends up falling in love with Jhilik, his daughter.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Laxmi, a milkmaid, falls in love with Kanchan, an influential zamindar's son. Things take a tragic turn when his family disapproves of their alliance.

title: Manush Keno Beiman
desc: L Chowdhury, a simple villager, who lives with his sister, finds his life turned upside down because of an unexpected accident.

title: Sukh Dukher Sansar
desc: Amar, the eldest of four, struggles to provide a better life to his younger siblings. However, things take a turn for the worse when his younger sister meets with an accident and is visually impaired.

title: Mayer Ashirbad
desc: After his mother's death, Modhu moves to the capital city where he becomes unpaid house help for his uncle. However, his fortune suddenly changes when he wins the lottery.

title: Jaatishwar
desc: When Rohit goes to Portugal in order to pursue his studies, he gets intrigued by the works of Hensman Anthony, hence reviews the life of the Bengali folk poet.

title: Arpan
desc: Anil loves Shobha and hopes to marry her. When he goes abroad for a year, he leaves her in charge of his family but upon his return, he is shell-shocked to learn that she has married someone else.

title: Patanjali Yog - By Yogrishi Swami Ramdev
desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Boudi Canteen
desc: Poulami leaves her job as a teacher in order to turn her love for cooking into a business. However, she must strive to not let her aspirations get crushed under the expectations of society.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Rajbadhu
desc: Ranjan loves Neela but introduces Pranati as his wife to his father. However, he accepts Pranati as his wife after seeing Neela with another man in a compromising position.
